chunks: I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: “I have prepared myself to remain committed to hajj every year, either myself or through a man from my household, with my wealth.”
So he said: “And have you firmly resolved upon that?” I said: “Yes, I have indeed firmly resolved upon that.”
So he said: “If you do that, then be certain of abundance of wealth, or receive glad tidings of abundance of wealth.”

key_terms.كُلَّ عَامٍ: every year on a recurring basis

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about committing to perform hajj every year?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a man’s firm resolve to perform hajj every year, either personally or by deputing someone from his household at his expense. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام affirms that such sustained commitment to hajj is associated with abundant wealth and glad tidings of financial increase.
